title: Tell Your Tech Career Story: Proof, Résumés, and Interviews
description: Turn your experience into a clear career story with achievement stories, proof of skills, a tailored résumé, and interview practice with Mentor AI.
summary: Turn your experience into a clear story that employers notice. Choose a target role, build a bank of honest achievement stories, curate proof of your skills, and write a résumé that you can tailor for a new posting in about thirty minutes.
takeaways: Then practice outreach and interviews in guided mentor sessions, and finish with an application campaign for real postings.
